verdict.rationale: Composio documents an official CLI that gives coding agents and people at the terminal a local tool surface. Through it they can connect apps, execute tools, inspect schemas, call authenticated APIs and debug projects. AI-native touches include `composio setup --target auto` for Codex/Claude Code plugins, `composio login --agent` for browserless agent sign-in, and agent plugins that drive actions through the CLI. A probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI working in practice.
